tribes.name: Alur
proverbs: Brothers who stay together are stronger than any spear.
A river does not refuse water.
A kind heart is worth more than any treasure.
The forest keeps the secrets of those who respect it.

tribes.name: Acholi
proverbs: A spear is kept for the day of trouble.
One finger cannot kill a louse.
The path to the well is made by many feet.
The reed that stands alone breaks; the reeds that bundle together build the granary.

tribes.name: Bunyoro
proverbs: Wisdom is better than strength.
A king is only a king through his people.
The sun shines for everyone in the kingdom.
Friendship is a shield against the dark.

tribes.name: Tooro
proverbs: He who climbs alone falls alone.
The mountain belongs to those who respect it.
Independence is the gift of courage.
The mist hides the peak but not the path.

tribes.name: Bagisu
tribes.heroTitle: Father of Imbalu, Son of the Mountain
proverbs: The mountain does not laugh at another mountain.
Courage is not the absence of fear, but facing it.
A man who stands alone stands on nothing.
Hard work turns a mountain into a garden.

tribes.name: Baganda
proverbs: Agali awamu gegaluma ennyama (Unity helps solve problems).
Wisdom is greater than gold.
Peace starts in a happy home.
Buganda nnamungi (Buganda is great).

tribes.name: Basongora
proverbs: A Queen's wisdom is the valley's shield.
Peace is the grass that feeds the heart.
The sun rises over the salt lakes first.
Kindness is a pot that never runs dry.

tribes.name: Jie Karamojong
proverbs: A man is only as rich as his herd.
Water is the blood of the dry land.
Even a spotted cow finds its way home.
Respect the elder as you respect the mountain.

tribes.name: Banyankole
proverbs: A brave heart is better than a thousand spears.
The arrow follows the eye of the wise.
Milk and peace go hand in hand.
United hills stand against the wind.

tribes.name: Bakiga
proverbs: A brave woman is the pillar of the hills.
Hard work turns a mountain into a garden.
Unity is the strength of the Bakiga.
Truth is a path that never ends.

tribes.name: Iteso
tribes.heroTitle: The Millet Farmer of the Plains
proverbs: A family that eats together stays together.
The sun shines on the hardworking farmer.
One grain of millet cannot fill a granary.
Peace is the best harvest of all.
